subject: Next steps: book trial kickoff & align success criteria
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ryan Caldwell <ryan.caldwell@clearwellhealth.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps: book trial kickoff & align success criteria

Hi Ryan / Lina —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed plan to lock the evaluation kickoff: 

Scope & success criteria (from today's call)
- Surface-level intent extraction and patient-note summarization for two clinical workflows (intake + discharge).
- Latency target: 300ms p50 for single-turn inference on 512 tokens.
- Quality target: F1 > 0.82 on our seeded prompt set and no PII leakage in outputs.

What we recommend for the kickoff (60 min):
- 10m: introductions & objectives
- 20m: technical deep dive (input formats, dataset sampling, integration paths)
- 20m: trial plan & success metrics (prompt pack, eval cadence, rollback criteria)
- 10m: actions & owners (security, contract, calendar lock)

Proposed 60-minute slots (PT) — please confirm one: 
- Wed Dec 2, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu Dec 3, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Fri Dec 4, 13:00–14:00 PT

Attached: MAP_trial_kickoff_template.pdf (mutual action plan), prompt-pack-template.csv (starter prompt set).

A couple of asks ahead of the kickoff:
- Can you confirm which environment you prefer for the trial (hosted API vs. dedicated dev pool vs. private deployment)?
- Please share your compliance contact for SOC2 / data handling questions (we'll pull the minimal artifact set).
- If possible, drop a small sample of representative inputs (sanitized) so Ben can prepare a focused demo.

If any of those slots don't work, tell me a couple times that do and I'll loop in Marissa to lock terms.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri y.om.das@redwoodinference.com
https://redwoodinference.com

Thanks Priyom — appreciated the clear recap. Dec 3, 10:00–11:00 PT works for us.

Couple quick notes from our side:
- We'll plan to attend with Product (me) + Compliance (Lina Gomez) + 1 engineer (Tariq). Lina is cc'd — Lina, can you confirm?
- For the trial environment, we're leaning toward Redwood hosted API initially; we may request a dedicated dev pool if the throughput tests look promising.
- Can you provide a ballpark pilot cost estimate or a sample pricing scenario we can include in the internal MPA?
- We'll only provide sanitized examples; I'll share a 10–15 row CSV of representative inputs before EOD Monday.

Ryan Caldwell

Looping in a quick technical plan so we go into the kickoff with a tight agenda. CC'd Ryan/Lina for visibility.

I'll own the technical deep dive — plan to cover:
- Example inference flow (API payloads + expected outputs)
- Tokenization and cost expectations for the sample prompts
- Suggested prompt set modifications (we'll pre-run the prompt-pack-template.csv)
- Integration patterns (direct REST vs. SDK + batching tips)
- Data handling & KV cache considerations for sessions

Prep items from Redwood (I'll attach): tech-deepdive-agenda.docx, plus I will pre-run three prompts in a private sandbox and share the redacted results in the drive link before the call.

Marissa — can you prepare a short summary of trial terms (trial length, allowed usage, pre-populated MPA clause language) so we can hand off to their procurement after the kickoff?

Thanks — I'll hold Dec 3 10:00–11:00 PT and will post a calendar invite once Priyom confirms.

— Ben
